children: BANK OF CANADA GOVERNOR MACKLEM SAYS BOC'S MESSAGE IS IF A SUPPLY SHOCK IS TEMPORARY IT STILL MAKES SENSE TO SEE THROUGH IT
MACKLEM SAYS IF INFLATION EXPECTATIONS STAY WELL ANCHORED WE MAY STILL NEED TO RESPOND
MACKLEM SAYS IN THAT CASE THOUGH WE WON'T HAVE TO RESPOND AS MUCH
MACKLEM SAYS MORTGAGE DELINQUENCIES HAVE NOW NORMALIZED
MACKLEM SAYS OVERALL LEVEL OF MORTAGE ARREARS IS NOT THAT HIGH
MACKLEM SAYS HOUSING MARKET IS CERTAINLY SOFT, WE DON'T SEE IT LEADING THE RECOVERY
MACKLEM SAYS OIL PRICES HAVE COME DOWN FROM OCTOBER
MACKLEM SAYS IF ENERGY PRICES COME DOWN FASTER INFLATION SHOULD TOO, AND THERE SHOULD BE LESS REASON TO RAISE RATES
MACKLEM SAYS WHEN IT COMES TO INFLATION RATE, WE TAKE BELOW AND ABOVE EQUALLY SERIOUSLY
MACKLEM SAYS HAVING THE INFLATION FORECAST NOT GOING UP IS BETTER
MACKLEM SAYS DON'T EXPECT EXCHANGE RATE PASS THROUGH WILL BE A BIG FACTOR
MACKLEM SAYS HE CHOSE TO ANNOUNCE DEPARTURE IN JUNE, DID NOT SEEK EXTENSION

title: Bank Of Canada Governor Macklem Says BOC's Message Is If A Supply Shock Is Temporary It Still Makes Sense To See Through It
